tasks.short: Study historical climate indicators to develop climate models.

steps.what: Study actual ice-sheet, rock-formation or related historical climate indicators through direct examination and contextual geological assessment
inputs: actual specimens or formations
existing site and sampling context
outputs: actual indicator observations and geological context

steps.what: Verify actual proxy measurements, dating information, sample provenance and uncertainty before modeling
inputs: actual indicator observations and geological context
actual laboratory proxy and dating records
outputs: verified proxy dataset and uncertainty limits

steps.what: Align verified proxy series, units and chronology references for the explicitly chosen climate comparison
inputs: verified proxy dataset and uncertainty limits
scientist's explicit alignment rules
outputs: aligned proxy comparison with chronology exceptions in climate analysis software {OTHER}

steps.what: Develop and compare climate model variants using the verified indicators and explicit scientific assumptions
inputs: aligned proxy comparison with chronology exceptions in climate analysis software {OTHER}
human-chosen model assumptions and parameter variants
outputs: actual model comparisons, residuals and failed variants

steps.what: Interpret the indicators and model comparisons and write and check the actual findings, chronology uncertainty and model limitations
inputs: actual model comparisons, residuals and failed variants
verified proxy dataset and uncertainty limits
outputs: checked final climate-study findings and internal location

steps.what: Save the checked climate-study findings and model references to the internal research record
inputs: checked final climate-study findings and internal location
outputs: stored climate-study findings

tasks.design: Test native chronology, unit and variant-comparison facilities in climate analysis software {OTHER}. Reuse explicit scientific settings and source references, while keeping direct study, source validation, assumptions and interpretation with the geoscientist.
tasks.previous_blocker: Comparable series and model variants can require repeated human preparation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native configurations can reuse verified alignment rules and parameter tables.
tasks.still_hard: Dating uncertainty, proxy meaning and alternative climate explanations.
tasks.human_edge: Recognizing when a numerical fit lacks geological support.

ambition.what: Compare an additional explicit chronology assumption before choosing the reported interpretation.

tasks.altitude: Less repeated alignment and run setup, unchanged scientific responsibility.

reach.task: Assess the sensitivity of a proxy-based interpretation
reach.learn: Carry dating uncertainty through comparisons rather than treating dates as exact.

evidence.claim: Native scientific tools can reuse alignment and parameter configurations while scientific assumptions and proxy interpretation remain human.

assumptions: Boundary includes direct indicator study, verification, modeling and its actual findings. Laboratory staff effort, independent dating work and model runtime receive no saving. Actual indicator observations remain counted, not inferred from a model input file.

Laboratory and dataset owners produce sample ID, measured proxy, units, actual age estimate, uncertainty, method and source reference; the geoscientist supplies actual contextual observations and alignment and model assumptions. Missing provenance or uncertain mappings require manual review, not automatic interpolation presented as fact.
Try native analysis facilities first. Only repeated series preparation and model-variant setup lose time; model choice, scientific judgement and runtime are not assigned automation gains.
a1 binds the finished findings, model versions, uncertainty and internal record checked during authoring in s5. Edits require rechecking; no public report or submission is included.
unknowns: Current reuse of native alignment and variant configurations.
Fraction of human work spent preparing repeated variants.
research_questions: Can chronology exceptions remain visible through native model comparisons?

already_counted.description: Review aligned data and model variants and write and check findings.

incremental.description: Maintain unit, chronology and model-version mappings.

approvals.approved_version: Final climate-study findings, source and model references, uncertainty and internal destination checked in s5

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Alignment mechanics save 7.5 points and model setup mechanics 7; gross 14.5 less 1.5 upkeep. Low is no deployment when configurations are already reused or sources require manual handling.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Review remediation work plans for effectiveness.

steps.what: Retrieve the actual remediation work-plan revision and authorized soil or groundwater evidence
inputs: actual work-plan revision
site evidence references
outputs: matched work plan and site evidence

steps.what: Read the proposed activities and evaluate the actual site contamination, pathways, targets and evidence limits
inputs: matched work plan and site evidence
outputs: human understanding of proposed mitigation and site limitations

steps.what: Cross-reference proposed mitigation activities and monitoring claims to their exact work-plan passages and source evidence
inputs: matched work plan and site evidence
human understanding of proposed mitigation and site limitations
outputs: checked factual activity-evidence table with omissions and uncertainty

loop.purpose: Draft factual cross-references for nonstandard plan prose, without judging remediation effectiveness
loop.input: Fixed actual work-plan revision and authorized site evidence
loop.output: Activity-evidence table with exact source passages, qualifications and missing-evidence flags
loop.check: The geoscientist checks every activity, negation, condition and claimed monitoring link against the full source meaning; unsupported claims are removed
loop.stop: One corrected draft at most, then manual cross-referencing if any factual or qualification error remains
loop.why_not_simpler: Use native headings and searches first; variable plan prose can still require contextual matching that fixed fields do not supply

steps.what: Determine the effectiveness and limitations of the proposed activities for mitigating soil or groundwater contamination
inputs: checked factual activity-evidence table with omissions and uncertainty
matched work plan and site evidence
outputs: human effectiveness judgement and requested changes

steps.what: Write and check the actual review findings, supporting passages, limitations and required clarifications
inputs: human effectiveness judgement and requested changes
outputs: checked final remediation-plan review and exact internal project target

steps.what: Save the checked actual remediation work-plan review to the internal project record
inputs: checked final remediation-plan review and exact internal project target
outputs: stored actual remediation-plan review

tasks.design: Link the current plan and site evidence in {DOCS}; try native headings and search before a bounded factual cross-reference draft. The geoscientist verifies every proposed activity and qualification, then makes the effectiveness judgement and writes the actual review.
tasks.previous_blocker: Nonstandard work plans make evidence cross-referencing repetitive.
tasks.enabler_now: A source-bounded draft can suggest passage links while leaving scientific judgement human.
tasks.still_hard: Predicting effectiveness under uncertain subsurface conditions.
tasks.human_edge: Recognizing unsupported mitigation assumptions and consequential evidence gaps.

ambition.what: No automatic remediation approval or broader review authority is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Less passage matching, unchanged remediation judgement.

reach.task: Discuss whether proposed monitoring tests the mitigation hypothesis
reach.learn: Separate an activity description from evidence that it will work.

evidence.claim: A bounded text draft can propose factual passage cross-references, but its meaning and qualifications need human verification.

assumptions: Boundary is reviewing an actual plan and its existing review record. Sampling, remediation execution, regulatory decisions and onward advice sends are separate work, not free outputs of this review.

The plan author supplies actual revision and proposed activities; site evidence owners supply sample IDs, dates, locations, results, methods and uncertainty. The geoscientist verifies source versions. Missing sources, inaccessible scans or failed extraction require manual reading and cross-referencing.

Native templates, heading search and source links are tested first; use the loop only for the remaining nonstandard prose. Its output never scores effectiveness or invents contamination facts. The full scientific reading and judgement remain counted.
a1 binds the final review and exact internal project target checked in s5. Edits require rechecking; the save earns no saving.
unknowns: Whether source-linked cross-reference checking is faster than manual matching for these plans.
research_questions: Does the bounded draft preserve negation, conditions and missing evidence in a representative plan sample?

already_counted.description: Verify factual cross-references and write and check actual review findings.

incremental.description: Maintain source access and test extraction and qualification errors after changes.

approvals.approved_version: Complete final remediation-plan review, evidence references, limitations and exact internal project target checked in s5

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Retrieval saves 4 points and factual cross-referencing 7; gross 11 less 1.5 upkeep. Low is no deployment if verification removes the gain or native links already solve it.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Assess water movement and provide site or waste-management advice.

steps.what: Retrieve actual ground or surface water observations and the client's site or waste-management question
inputs: actual client question
actual water observations and site records
outputs: matched water and site evidence

steps.what: Examine actual site conditions and verify water observation locations, conditions and evidence gaps
inputs: matched water and site evidence
actual site conditions
outputs: verified site context and water evidence limits

steps.what: Prepare comparable water-level, datum and time views in hydrogeological analysis software {OTHER}
inputs: verified site context and water evidence limits
actual water observations and site records
explicit compatible datum and unit rules
outputs: source-linked water movement evidence views and incompatibilities

steps.what: Assess ground or surface water movement, competing explanations and implications for waste management, site selection or restoration
inputs: source-linked water movement evidence views and incompatibilities
verified site context and water evidence limits
actual client question
outputs: human water-movement assessment and justified advice

steps.what: Write and check the actual advice, evidence, uncertainty, scope and exact client delivery package
inputs: human water-movement assessment and justified advice
outputs: checked final water-movement advice and exact record and client destinations

steps.what: Save the checked exact water-movement advice to the internal project record
inputs: checked final water-movement advice and exact record and client destinations
outputs: stored actual water-movement advice

steps.what: Send only the checked exact water-movement advice package to the authorized client recipient
inputs: checked final water-movement advice and exact record and client destinations
outputs: actual advice dispatch

tasks.design: Use native hydrogeological analysis views {OTHER} to align actual compatible observations and expose missing datum or time information. Keep site examination, water-movement interpretation and advice writing human; save and client send are separate checked actions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated observation retrieval and compatible-series arrangement can be cumbersome.
tasks.enabler_now: Native dated and spatial views can reuse verified units and datum references.
tasks.still_hard: Separating real movement from sparse data, temporal variation or observation error.
tasks.human_edge: Understanding geological context and stating what the evidence cannot support.

ambition.what: Compare an alternative water-movement explanation before final advice.

tasks.altitude: Less data arrangement, unchanged advisory authority.

reach.task: Discuss water movement implications for a restoration design
reach.learn: Explain uncertainty and distinguish measured levels from interpreted movement.

evidence.claim: Native hydrogeological views can arrange compatible dated observations while interpretation and advice remain human.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual site verification, assessment and written advice. Existing measurement producers' labour receives no saving; any new required measurement campaign must be budgeted separately, not treated as generated data.

Observation owners supply location, timestamp, water level or flow, units, vertical datum, method and quality status. The geoscientist supplies actual site context and comparison rules. Missing datum or incompatible observations are manually resolved and cannot become a smooth inferred trend.
Try native data links and views first. No model determines water movement, remediation safety or site suitability. Computational runtime receives no labour benefit.
a1 and a2 bind the complete final advice, uncertainty, exact internal record and client recipient checked during s5. Edits void both; ordinary save and send remain fully retained.
unknowns: Current datum completeness and native view usage.
research_questions: Can native views keep incompatible observation sets explicit rather than silently merging them?

already_counted.description: Review arranged evidence and write and check actual advice.

incremental.description: Maintain observation links and datum and unit compatibility rules.

approvals.approved_version: Complete final water-movement advice, evidence, uncertainty and exact internal record checked in s5
Complete final water-movement advice package and exact authorized client recipient checked in s5

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Retrieval saves 3 points and compatible evidence arrangement 10; gross 13 less 1 upkeep. Low is no adoption when views are already native or sources require manual work.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Examine actual terrain, formations and observed conditions relevant to mudslides, earthquakes or volcanic hazards
inputs: actual site or region
existing geological question
actual observable conditions
outputs: actual geological observations and context

steps.what: Retrieve and verify relevant geological records, actual hazard observations and dated event evidence
inputs: actual geological observations and context
authorized dated geological and event datasets
outputs: checked hazard evidence set and source limitations

steps.what: Arrange compatible geological and event evidence layers for the scientist's explicit hazard comparisons in geospatial software {OTHER}
inputs: checked hazard evidence set and source limitations
explicit spatial, time and unit compatibility choices
outputs: source-linked hazard evidence views and missing coverage

steps.what: Identify justified natural-disaster risks and write and check the evidence, uncertainty, scope and limits of the findings
inputs: source-linked hazard evidence views and missing coverage
actual geological observations and context
outputs: checked final natural-hazard findings and internal location

steps.what: Save the checked actual natural-hazard findings to the internal research or project record
inputs: checked final natural-hazard findings and internal location
outputs: stored actual natural-hazard findings

tasks.design: Configure native source-linked geological and event views in geospatial software {OTHER}. Reduce retrieval and layer arrangement while retaining actual observations, scientific hazard judgement and the complete findings; no automatic public warning or risk score is issued.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant dated evidence can require repeated retrieval and layer arrangement.
tasks.enabler_now: Native spatial views can preserve provenance and expose missing coverage.
tasks.still_hard: Sparse evidence, uncertain triggers and interpreting hazard context.
tasks.human_edge: Recognizing where a map supports a finding and where it does not.

ambition.what: No automatic warning service or additional disaster-prediction authority is proposed.

tasks.altitude: Less evidence handling, unchanged scientific and public-warning authority.

reach.task: Understand the limits of a geological hazard finding
reach.learn: Distinguish source coverage from the absence of a hazard.

evidence.claim: Native geospatial views can reduce repeated evidence handling without establishing or communicating a hazard judgement automatically.

assumptions: Boundary is scientific risk identification and its internal findings. External warnings, emergency actions and regulatory decisions are separate workflows and receive no automatic action or saving here.

Authorized geological and monitoring owners produce event ID, actual date, location, measurement type, units, quality, coverage and source revision. The geoscientist supplies actual observations and comparison choices. Missing evidence remains missing; planned monitoring is not an observed event.

Try native linked views before code. Layer arrangement is deterministic only after human compatibility choices; no model infers a hazard, diagnoses imminent events or converts absent data into low risk.
a1 binds the complete findings, uncertainty, scope and exact internal destination checked in s4. Edits require rechecking and the ordinary save earns no benefit.
unknowns: Source coverage and current native geospatial configuration.
research_questions: Can the view preserve missing and outdated evidence visibly through the review?

already_counted.description: Check arranged evidence and identify and document actual hazard findings.

incremental.description: Maintain source revisions and spatial and time compatibility mappings.

approvals.approved_version: Complete final natural-hazard findings, evidence limitations, scope and exact internal record checked in s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Evidence retrieval saves 7.5 points and layer arrangement 8; gross 15.5 less 1.5 upkeep. Low is no deployment when sources are manual or native tools already remove the repeated work.

role.altitude: The geoscientist keeps observation and scientific judgement, using native views and a bounded factual text helper only where repeated evidence handling remains.
reach: Discuss evidence limits in remediation and site-planning reviews with environmental engineers.
role.ambitious_version: Test a competing explanation or unresolved plan assumption earlier while retaining the same scientific evidence standards.
